librispeech.authors: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey, Sanjeev Khudanpur
librispeech.reference_origin: human-authored audiobook text, corpus segmentation/alignment; not bespoke verbatim dictation gold

validation.reason: AMI word times are forced-alignment-derived and these human utterance segments are not professional subtitle cues.

provenance.speaker: D
provenance.normalization: Speaker labels and bracketed non-speech events are excluded from scoring. AMI underscore-spelled initialisms are joined by the WER normalizer.
provenance.notes: Close-talking channel for one speaker. Word timings inside segments are forced alignments; cue boundaries are human-adjusted utterances, not professional subtitle breaks.

excluded_earnings21.reason: Existing public source-nlp/4363614.nlp ts/endTs are empty; cannot safely pair short audio cuts with gold without new alignment. No old inference outputs opened or used for selection. No downloads or inference for Earnings-21.

bounded_source_inspection.disposition: Not materialized. Read-speech focus explicitly documented; does not close spontaneous dictation gap. en_us exists; accent diversity requires separate evidence.
Not materialized. Banking-intent speech; en-AU/en-GB/en-US, 8kHz, approx 600 examples/config, train-only. Potential future short/accent probe, not part of this frozen bounded preparation.

coverage_gaps: No verified accent strata or speaker accent labels
No heldout spontaneous/self-correction corpus; AMI is one already-public dev-only speaker
LibriSpeech uppercase unpunctuated references cannot establish punctuation/case/number-formatting parity
Noise/pause/cutoff are deterministic synthetic diagnostics, not real environmental noise or natural endpoint timing
Read audiobooks may overlap model training/evaluation; corpus metadata/card exposure is not model-independent real-world evidence
Only 20 heldout speaker clusters and 40 clips; strict noninferiority can remain inconclusive
